releaseNotes: Owli for your computer: the full workspace, with a sidebar, a class dashboard, the month attendance grid and the class record as a spreadsheet.
Phone and computer: copy everything between your phone and your computer over Wi-Fi, and keep going on the other device. It's a copy, not live sync; both need this version.
After a copy, Owli tells you which device has the newer copy and warns before replacing changes.
Each class has its own colour, the same on your phone and computer.
School calendar: enter your period dates once, and Owli knows the current period.
No-class days: record holidays and class suspensions so they don't count as days without attendance.
